description: Advanced filtering API for ZO-SENTINEL registry. FastAPI port 8784. GET /filter with params: verdict, min_score, max_score, threat_type, registry_source, date_range. Queries mcp_server_registry + mcp_threat_associations via ws_query. Returns paginated results with filter summary. run() daemon pattern.

next_directive.description: Deep forensic detail API for a single MCP server. FastAPI port 8785. GET /forensics/{server_id} returns: full signal history, threat timeline, hash mutation log, attestation history, approval decisions, risk rank history. All from ws_query across mcp_signal_scores, mcp_threat_associations, mcp_attestations, mcp_decisions. run() daemon.

Compliance export daemon for ZO-SENTINEL. Generates periodic compliance reports as JSON and Markdown. Reads mcp_server_registry, mcp_decisions, mcp_risk_register. Writes COMPLIANCE_REPORT.md and compliance_export.json to /home/workspace/zo_sentinel/. Runs every 24h. ws_write heartbeat. run() daemon.

Manual override API for InfoSec analysts. FastAPI port 8786. POST /override/{server_id} with body {verdict, reason, analyst, duration_days} writes override to mcp_server_registry. GET /overrides lists active overrides. Overrides expire after duration_days. Audit logged to mcp_decisions. run() daemon.

Single-page HTML status dashboard for ZO-SENTINEL. Shows: pipeline health (daemons up/down), registry stats (total MCPs, by verdict), recent threats (last 5), latest attestations, build manifest (last 10 builds). Polls /api/search, /v1/registry, /v1/threats every 30s. Dark brutalist style matching existing UI. Self-contained HTML with embedded JS.
